implemented_subclauses: Candidate predicate: when the normal note type differs from the current note type, encode that difference with normal-type and its normal-dot content. When it is the same, normal-type may be omitted. Normal dots belong to the normal side of the relation, not automatically to the current note. Missing explicit normal-type does not itself prove a difference or failure; undecidable intended type remains unknown. Source evaluation uses observed structure, normalized values, and explicit presence. Model evaluation uses current model fields and presence only, without serialization, reparsing, or invented source spelling. Unknown or unsupported prerequisites produce incomplete results, never absence or success; invalid prerequisites block with a causal DecisionRef. Context defaults apply only to known absence. Resource limits are incomplete, not MusicXML defects. These are review-gated planning contracts and unexecuted future test cases.
